faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Tata Memorial Centre - Centre for Cancer Epidemiology (TMC ACTREC) for their upcoming project-based requirements in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post notified under this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notified post is Project Manager under the Centre for Cancer Epidemiology department.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Manager position under the current notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Manager role?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MBBS, BAMS, BHMS, or BDS degree from a recognized institution along with a PG Diploma in Clinical Research or equivalent qualification and mandatory three years of experience in clinical research.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Manager role will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 45,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for TMC ACTREC Project Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be based entirely on a walk-in interview conducted directly by the recruiting organization.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 02-11-2026 with a reporting time of 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for applying to this job?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly walk-in. Candidates do not need to submit applications online beforehand unless specified, but must report directly to the venue with required documents.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their bio-data, original certificates, qualification documents, experience certificates, birth certificate, passport-size photographs, PAN card, and a complete set of Xerox copies.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the official website to check further details?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official website of the organization at www.actrec.gov.in to check official updates and further announcements regarding the recruitment process.
